description: This file defines the Expanded formatter class used in the SCSSPHP library for formatting SCSS into CSS, specifically providing an expanded, human-readable output style.

classes.name: Expanded
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs CSS in an expanded, human-readable style, extending the base Formatter class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes formatting properties such as indentation, line breaks, braces, separators, and semicolon retention for the expanded output style.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current indentation level, used to indent nested CSS rules and properties.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines of a CSS block with proper indentation, handling comment lines and line breaks appropriately.
